caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular wooden post or beam standing vertically, occupying the center of the composition. The object appears to be a three-dimensional, block-shaped piece of wood with visible grain patterns and a light beige or tan color. There are dark brown or black marks, knots, and blemishes scattered irregularly along its length, suggesting natural imperfections in the wood. The object is shown with two faces visible, with one face receiving more direct light and appearing lighter, while the adjacent face is in shadow and appears darker. The edges of the wooden post are sharp and well defined, and two circular holes are present near the top on the lighter face and the adjacent darker face. The background is plain and off-white with a thin, rectangular border framing the drawing. The name “Annie B. Johnston” is written in small, neat handwriting near the lower right corner within the border.
title: Pottery Grave Post
